annotations.title: Read a model number from a photo

description: Read the brand, model and part numbers from a photo of a label or nameplate and match them to products. Matches are returned as candidates, with what was read. The photo isn't stored.

hint.description: Optional context, e.g. 'refrigerator label inside the door'.

image.description: A photo of the label or nameplate as a data URL (data:image/jpeg;base64,...), under 4 MB.

name: identify_from_photo
title: Read a model number from a photo
